newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - Aug 19.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's Daily Variety:
* Billy Bob Thornton is in serious talks to make Cormac McCarthy's novel, "All the Pretty Horses", his first directing project since "Sling Blade."
* George Clooney and his film production partner Robert Lawrence are going forward with 12 feature pictures -- seven of which they announced Monday.
* Fox Broadcasting and producer Twentieth Television have tapped Vicki Lawrence as "Fox After Breakfast"'s permanent host.
* Computers and telecommunications technology such as the Internet promise to revolutionize the way tens of thousands of union actors find out about available acting gigs.
* Richard Donner will produce and possibly direct the tentatively titled "Inside Out" for Polygram.
* Ted Demme has inked a deal to direct Eddie Murphy, and likely Martin Lawrence, in the Imagine Entertainment film "Life" for Universal Pictures, sources said.
